home.title: Authentic Indian Cuisine in Central Florida
home.description: Since 1996, Amrit Palace has served authentic Indian cuisine in Ocala & Gainesville, FL. Tandoor grills, rich curries, fresh breads, craft cocktails. Reserve a table or order online.

menu.title: Menu
menu.description: Explore the full Amrit Palace menu — appetizers, tandoori, curries, biryani, vegetarian dishes, fresh breads, desserts, and a full bar of cocktails, wine, and beer.

catering.title: Catering
catering.description: Full-service Indian catering for weddings, corporate events, and private celebrations across Central Florida. Buffet displays, live stations, and professional service.

giftCards.title: Gift Cards
giftCards.description: Give a taste of tradition. Amrit Palace e-gift cards from $25 to $200 — delivered instantly, valid for 12 months at both Ocala and Gainesville locations.

about.title: About
about.description: From our family to yours — over 30 years of celebrating Indian cuisine with passion, authenticity, and heart. The story of Amrit Palace, founded 1996.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Get in touch with Amrit Palace. Two Central Florida locations in Ocala and Gainesville — addresses, phone numbers, hours, and reservations.
